author: NikoBellicIV
quote:
This game was clearly not made for Grand Theft Auto fans. We waited 13 years for this game, and what we got was a (at best) 30FPS mess **** that tries extremely hard not to be a GTA game at every step of the way. 

The story is mind numbingly boring, there has not been a single iconic scene that I've seen yet! The romance between Jason and Lucia feels extremely childish and shallow. The humor and satire from all the previous GTA games is non existent. The characters are forgettable with zero impact. When you play GTA, you want to rob banks and do cool ****, not buy groceries for your virtual baby mama and paint walls. Games are about escaping reality and having fun, this game forces you to waste hours of your life doing the most mundane activities. Also, the game does not allow you to make your own choices. You cannot shoot up nightclubs, you cannot harm protesters, you cannot steal cars in your neighborhood, etc... Did the people that made this game even play a single older GTA? This game feels like RDR3.

Moving on to the gameplay, the shooting mechanics feel extremely stale. They are directly imported from RDR2, which seems fine on paper, except when you realize GTA is not about a slow paced story in the Wild West, but a cartoony game about organized crime, police chases, shoot outs, bank robberies, etc... Several new mechanics have been added that complicate things that would be one button away in previous GTA titles. Why do I need to complete some half baked boring minigame to steal a car? Who asked for this? Even if it doesn't seem like a big deal at first glance, when you play a game for thousands of hours, this adds up. Small things like this make the game too tedious and **** all the fun out of it. Again, this is a GAME, not a real life simulator. The driving feels like a mix between GTA IV and V, which would be fine if it wasn't for the FPS drops if you go fast. 30 FPS in November 2026 is unacceptable, you cannot play this game without experience nausea. There are a bunch of tedious mechanics in the gameplay, like buying groceries/food, which would take too long to list. The overall point is that the gameplay is too slow, tedious, boring and has moved away from what GTA is, in a bad way.

The user interface is atrocious. This is something most people will completely overlook, but the UI of a video game is its heart and soul. You can tell how much love went into the game by looking at its UI. The UI in this game is extremely minimalistic, corporate and ugly. You could make a better UI using Claude ffs! 13 years and 2 billion dollars for this sorry excuse of a UI? This is undefendable even by the biggest Rockstar fanboys. The UI is the final nail in the coffin that makes this game feel more like a cheap GTA clone built on RDR2's engine than the next entry in the most successful video game title of all time.

To sum up, GTA VI is a corporate, safe game made for everyone but the fans of this franchise. The game feels like a cash grab made to maximize sales numbers, while reducing the chance of controversy to the minimum. This is the first GTA that has not received extreme public scrutiny from the media, and for obvious reasons. It is an absolute sell out, that will trick a lot of people that don't know any better with its beautiful graphics and immersive world. The world looks incredible, the random events are great, the graphics look immaculate, but this game will leave you unfulfilled and empty. That's because the soul of this franchise is long gone, leaving only an empty shell that is going to look more shiny and more polished with each new GTA, yet the players are going to wonder why the games feel worse and worse. Extremely disappointing from Rockstar games, but it's what was to be expected looking at signs from the company this last decade. The people know what Rockstar games has become, and we will no longer hold them on a pedestal. I hope this game crashes and burns to show the Gaming Industry what happens when you delay the most highly anticipated video game for years and years, you do a "physical release" of the game with NO DISC, you lock playable content of the base game behind a $20 paywall to market the game for $80 dollars, you hire 1600 Indians to cut costs, illegally pay every game journalist for 100/100 ratings, write a terrible story that is antithetical to the themes of the game and delay the PC release to shamelessly double dip on your customers and expect us to buy both the console and PC editions. Screw Rockstar and the glazers of this game.

There are a LOT of other issues with this game that I'm not getting into but other reviewers mention. A 0/10 Rating is too generous.
